title: How a Godly Man Kills the Sin He's Stopped Calling Sin
caption:
How a godly man kills the sin he's stopped calling sin.

The ones you've renamed are the ones still running you. "That's just how I am" used to be a confession. Now it's a shrug.

Paul didn't say manage your flesh. He said put it to death (Romans 8:13). And James doesn't let you do it alone: confess to one another, not just to God in the privacy of your own head.

You don't kill it once. You kill it again tomorrow.
